text:
If your Friday plans have stayed dry so far, that’s been the right call, with partly cloudy skies, a west wind, and temperatures around 57. A stray shower can still pop up this afternoon, but this looks more hit-or-miss than a washout, with a high near 59. The breeze will freshen, and the lake will get choppier, with waves building to 2 to 3 feet, so keep smaller boats close to shore.

Any shower threat fades before 7, leaving a partly cloudy, chilly evening and a low around 40. Tomorrow is the payoff, with full sun, a light north wind, and a high near 57. Enjoy the afternoon outdoors with a light jacket handy, and plan on a mostly dry, calm waterfront day Saturday.
